程序包 org.bukkit.block

接口 Block

所有超级接口:
Metadatable
public interface Block extends Metadatable
Represents a block. This is a live object, and only one Block may exist for any given location in a world. The state of the block may change concurrently to your own handling of it; use block.getState() to get a snapshot state of a block which will not be modified. 表示一个方块。这是一个活动对象，世界中每个给定位置只能存在一个 Block。方块的状态可能与你的处理并发地改变；使用 block.getState() 来获取一个不会被修改的方块快照状态。

      • getRelative(BlockFace, int)

    • getRelative

      Block getRelative(BlockFace face, int distance)
      Gets the block at the given distance of the given face 获取给定面上指定距离处的方块

      For example, the following method places water at 100,102,100; two blocks above 100,100,100. 例如，以下方法会在 100,102,100 处放置水；即 100,100,100 上方两格。 

       Block block = world.getBlockAt(100, 100, 100);
 Block shower = block.getRelative(BlockFace.UP, 2);
 shower.setType(Material.WATER);
      参数:
      face - Face of this block to return 要返回的此方块的朝向面
      distance - Distance to get the block at 获取方块的距离
      返回:
      Block at the given face 给定面上的方块

      If the provided Location is null this method does nothing and returns null. 如果提供的 Location 为 null，此方法不执行任何操作并返回 null。

    • getFace

      BlockFace getFace(Block block)
      Gets the face relation of this block compared to the given block. 获取此方块相对于给定方块的朝向面关系。

      For example: 

      
 Block current = world.getBlockAt(100, 100, 100);
 Block target = world.getBlockAt(100, 101, 100);

 current.getFace(target) == BlockFace.Up;

      If the given block is not connected to this block, null may be returned 如果给定的方块未与此方块相连，则可能返回 null
      参数:
      block - Block to compare against this block 要与此方块比较的方块
      返回:
      BlockFace of this block which has the requested block, or null 此方块中朝向所请求方块的 BlockFace，或为 null

    • getState

      BlockState getState()
      Captures the current state of this block. You may then cast that state into any accepted type, such as Furnace or Sign. 捕获此方块的当前状态。然后你可以将该状态转换为任何可接受的类型，例如 Furnace 或 Sign。

      The returned object will never be updated, and you are not guaranteed that (for example) a sign is still a sign after you capture its state. 返回的对象永远不会被更新，并且（例如）无法保证在你捕获其状态后告示牌仍然是告示牌。

      返回:
      BlockState with the current state of this block. 包含此方块当前状态的 BlockState。
